runtime_overrides.observation: Constructor sets stkAccount index0 although designer index2. Tabs use original labels and exclusive check states. Runtime stylesheet: QPushButton bold18px PingFang; #AAAAAA normal / #444444 checked; checked bottom5px rgba(kMatchColor).

Combos use QListView plus comboboxStyle::getStrSheet, which comes from theme/listWidgetRowSelected. Arrow resource is :/image/arrow_drop_down.svg,25x25; drop-down20px, popup item height50px; normal font18px, popup20px.
Parent frmUserSet sets stkUserCenter stylesheet to buttonStyle::getStrSheet, so isolated extraction must preserve inherited button style. Base parent background is white.
Account table item fonts set PingFang13pt and centered; row height41px. Source .ui header hidden, columns3,131px default section, last stretch; no horizontal scrollbar.
getConfig requests Fusion and loads theme values from theme_config.ini else config.ini. Static audit reads only source; active original theme/Windows font metrics have not been measured.

CusMessageBox uses original UI, mask animation and stay-on-top modal exec. Information/warning/error show Sure only; question shows Sure and Cancel. Close yields NoButton; Sure=Yes, Cancel=No. Icons/button border images are relative ./resource/messagebox/*.png.

checks: Preserve original1471x881 page; left table10,30,391x811; right group410,30,641x811. If using independent host, host/footer are outside the business region.
Do not redesign color, tab order, layout, controls or original messages. Avoid introducing experiment banners inside the business area.
Validate actual cropping already present in source (tabs container761px inside641px parent; source root broader than content); do not silently rearrange.
Designer combo labels differ from runtime labels; slotUserChanged is required in the offline session initialization.
Only source/UI/C++ styles are established here. Original Windows runtime screenshot, active theme and RK target-screen visual equivalence are not passed.
Linux missing font replacement and invalid pointsize cleanup must be individually logged; capture same page/state/anonymous data/DPI.
Copy only required non-credential icons/resources; do not copy bin/configuration/database wholesale.
